title: Goal environment registry
description: contracts/env.yaml: every environment variable a Goal process reads, by name and meaning, with the non-secret default the code falls back to and when it is required. It never holds a secret or an example. tools/envcheck (task env:check) checks it against the code and generates docs/reference/environment.md from it.

allOf.description: A secret never gets a default.
requiredWhen qualifies required: false; a variable required everywhere needs no condition.

name.description: The variable's name, as the process reads it.

class.description: public: may be shown to anyone who uses the platform; config: a setting of the install, not a secret; secret: a credential.

required.description: true when a process that reads it refuses to start without it.

requiredWhen.description: One line, only with required: false: the reader or condition that makes the variable required, such as "goald under GOAL_AUTH=session".

default.description: One line: the value the code falls back to when the variable is unset. Never on a secret.

meaning.description: One line: what the variable sets.

indirect.description: For a name read by a key computed at run time: the file that names it, quoted. The variable counts as read while its name appears there.
